name: research-protocol-v1
note: Pre-registered before any backtest result was computed. Protected path: candidates and the generator cannot modify it.

validation.use: champion/challenger selection; every access is counted as a trial

final.use: vault: revealed once per campaign by the trusted supervisor; never mounted in candidate sandboxes

execution.funding: historical funding rate charged on position held at calc_time

promotion_rule.primary_metric: annualised net Sharpe of daily returns on the validation split (paired vs champion)

bootstrap.method: stationary block bootstrap of paired daily returns

statistics.multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni across hypotheses in a campaign report; Deflated Sharpe Ratio with N = number of validation trials
statistics.stopping: fixed budget per campaign, defined before the campaign; no sequential peeking at validation to extend it
